confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Colombo price levels, not checked against live listings or July 2026 data. Food and coffee anchors are moderate confidence. Alcohol anchors are weaker because Sri Lankan excise and bar pricing are high and have changed over time. Hostel and hotel anchors are the least certain, especially the three-star range. Rupee movements could also shift the USD values.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Sri Lanka's general price level within South Asia: food and coffee are set against typical Colombo local-restaurant and cafe prices, and accommodation against typical Colombo guesthouse and business-hotel rates. Cocktail and wine glass are derived from the beer anchor using multipliers of about 2.5x and 2.3x, because direct knowledge of local bar prices is weak.
